settings.ai.signInKeys: Sign in with your password to manage AI keys.
settings.ai.notAccepted: HolyArrs didn't accept that address. Copy the redirect URI from Gemini again, starting with https://.
settings.ai.shownOnce: {name}: it's shown only once. If you lose it, make a new one.
settings.ai.filledIn: It's filled into the steps and the agent prompt, and shown only now.
settings.ai.geminiHint: In Gemini, open Show more next to Advanced features and copy the redirect URI.
settings.ai.pasteGemini: Paste into Gemini, leave the secret empty, press Next
settings.ai.title: AI apps
settings.ai.intro: AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor can check your library, calendar and downloads, and request titles for you. They can only do what you allow, and every request they make shows in History.
settings.ai.ownerOnly: Only the owner can turn this on or off.
settings.ai.fact1: AI apps act as you, with your permissions and Limits
settings.ai.fact2: AI apps check with you before requesting. Only people approve.
settings.ai.fact3: At most 60 calls a minute and 5 requests an hour per app.
settings.ai.errorExpected: Shows an error in a browser; that's expected
settings.ai.turnOnFirst: Turn on Let AI apps connect above first. Until then, AI apps get "not found".
settings.ai.modeSignIn: Apps sign in through your browser. You press Allow once.
settings.ai.modeHttp: This is a plain-http address, so most apps won't sign in through the browser. Use an AI key: press Make a key next to your app below.
settings.ai.step1: In your AI app, add a custom connector or MCP server.
settings.ai.step3SignIn: HolyArrs opens in your browser. Sign in if it asks, then press Allow.
settings.ai.step3Key: Paste the AI key from Make a key where your app asks for a header or key.
settings.ai.cloudNeeds: Cloud AI apps (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity) need a public https address
settings.ai.agent: Or let your agent do it
settings.ai.agentPaste: Paste this into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or another agent
settings.ai.containsKey: Contains your key. Paste only into your own agent.
settings.ai.pressFirst: Press Make a key first to put your key in the prompt.
settings.ai.anyAnswer: Any answer about downloads means it works
settings.ai.linkedNote: Apps that sign in or use a key show here.
settings.ai.revokeDesc: The app loses access until you link it again
